full_name: Julie Orlemanski | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow The University of Chicago
bio: Julie Orlemanski studies medieval literature as well as theoretical and methodological questions in present-day literary studies, with special attention to how premodern texts challenge our familiar paradigms and assumptions. At Radcliffe, she will explore how the writings of the 14th-century poet Geoffrey Chaucer offer new problems and new insights in debates about literary character, narration, and figuration today.
